name: hiredeskhr-monorepo
description: HiredeskHR — Multi-tenant Applicant Tracking System for recruitment agencies

scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma generate --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=@hiredesk/shared && npm run build --workspace=@hiredesk/database && npm run build --workspace=@hiredesk/api && npm run build --workspace=@hiredesk/web
